Quick mode — Round 1: 5 Cursor specialists + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings.

**Rejected as OOS:** 4 — no-jq fallback (pre-existing degraded path), committed larch-logs (prior run), version bump (handled by bump-version step), step-prefix third-field injection risk (future concern only).

All reviewers returned substantive output. No round 2 needed (accepted work was non-substantial).
